content.caption: Diagram of a WikiSkill case study on ALFWorld (Qwen-3.6-27B). The right column is titled 'Active Skill Layer (skills/)' and has an icon of stacked orange folders, denoting the skills/ directory. LEFT COLUMN (three gray rounded boxes with monospace tab labels): (1) skill-impact.md, an audit trail of proposals. Next comes 'Iteration 1: create break-repetition-loop →' with a green ACCEPTED badge, an ellipsis, 'Iteration 4: update break-repetition-loop →' with a green ACCEPTED badge, and another ellipsis. Iteration 1: Errors Re-occurring (train: 01, 02); Use-Examine Loop (NEW) in train: 30, 31; Append fresh evidence to take-examine-move-loop.md; Accept skill 'break-repetition-loop' (val score = 0.78); then an ellipsis. (3) patterns, holding two sub-boxes. The first is take-examine-move-loop.md, with the italic text 'Agent takes an item, examines it, puts it back, and repeat.' and 'Evidence: Iter 0: train: 00, 02 | Iter 1: train: 01 | Iter 2-4: train: 02 persists; 00/01 show recovery from loops'. The second is multi-operation-loop.md, with the italic text 'Cycles actions on same item without checking completion.' and 'Evidence: Iter 2: train: 22, 24 | Iter 3-4: train: 24 persists'. RIGHT COLUMN: a large light-green box titled break-repetition-loop contains two darker green boxes. PURPOSE.md reads: 'Created as break-repetition-loop. Previous attempt goal-directed-action was rejected for being too abstract. This version is more concise and uses concrete action patterns.' SKILL.md contains: 'Trigger: Apply the skill whenever the agent is about to repeat an action.'; 'Rule: Never Return an Item to Its Origin Location', with '- Failing: take clock from desk -> examine -> move clock to desk' and '- Successful: take clock -> go to shelf -> move clock to shelf'; 'Rule: Agents that DO take items and perform operations often get stuck repeating the same operation. Each Operation Type ONCE Per Item'; and 'Anti-Pattern: Take -> Operate -> Move -> Take (INFINITE CYCLE)', with '- Fix: After completing take -> operate -> move ONCE, do NOT repeat.' Below it is a separate light-green box titled other-skill containing only '……', indicating further skills are omitted. ARROWS (curved and color-coded, each with a same-colored text label in the gap between the columns): (a) A red arrow runs from the Iteration 0 REJECTED badge into the PURPOSE.md box, labeled 'Prior Rejection History Explains Skill Rationale'. It ends in two arrowheads inside SKILL.md: one at the first Rule, near its Successful example, and one at the second Rule. Overall story: the Iteration 0 goal-directed-action proposal was rejected (val score 0.72). That rejection explains the rationale of the break-repetition-loop skill, which was accepted at Iteration 1 (val score 0.78) and updated again at Iteration 4 using the documented loop patterns.
